scenes.headline: How TwoTower gives a diffusion LM a frozen memory
scenes.sub: NVIDIA's split: a frozen autoregressive context tower and a trainable denoiser.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Zephyr! Diffusion language models write many tokens at once. NVIDIA's TwoTower gives one a frozen autoregressive memory. Here's how the towers work together.

scenes.label: The split
scenes.text: Stop making one network do two jobs: a frozen autoregressive tower holds the context, and a separate denoiser refines each block.
scenes.mark: Stop making one network do two jobs
scenes.say: The idea: stop asking one network to do two jobs that fight. A frozen autoregressive tower reads the context, and a separate denoiser refines each block.

scenes.title: Two towers, one block at a time

steps.say: The context tower is the pretrained autoregressive model, frozen. It reads the clean text causally and never gets a gradient.

steps.note: Mamba chunk size = diffusion block size
steps.say: It keeps the context as a KV cache and Mamba states, with Mamba's chunks matched to the block size.
The denoiser tower refines a block of masked tokens with bidirectional attention, cross-attending into the frozen tower, layer by layer.
The finished block is committed, and the next begins: autoregressive across blocks, diffusion within one.

items.say: Each block starts as sixteen masked tokens.
Every step, tokens whose confidence clears zero point eight are committed. Most resolve in the very first step.
The rest wait another step, so a block costs far fewer passes than it has tokens. That's the speedup.
One catch: sample with bigger blocks than it was trained on, and generation collapses.

scenes.label: of the autoregressive baseline's quality, at 2.42x its throughput
scenes.note: code and math drop the most
scenes.say: The result: ninety-eight point seven percent of the autoregressive baseline's quality, at two point four two times its throughput. Code and math take the biggest hits.

scenes.text: Freeze what already works, the causal reader, and spend all the training on the new part: bidirectional block refinement.
scenes.say: Freeze what already works, the causal reader, and spend all the training on the new part: refining blocks.

recap: A frozen AR tower holds the context
A trainable denoiser refines each block
scenes.say: To recap: a frozen reader, a trainable block denoiser, and nearly all the quality, generated much faster.
